name.en: Stree Shakti (free bus travel for women in Andhra Pradesh)

summary.en: Free travel anywhere in Andhra Pradesh on APSRTC Pallevelugu, Ultra Pallevelugu, City Ordinary, Express and Metro Express buses

benefit.value_note: Your saving depends on how often you travel

name.en: One valid ID: Aadhaar, Voter ID, Ration Card or Driving Licence (to show to the conductor)

en: There is no application. Board an eligible APSRTC bus within Andhra Pradesh.
Show one valid ID to the conductor and take your zero-fare ticket.
Not valid on non-stop services, chartered buses or interstate services.

to_confirm: You must be a resident of Andhra Pradesh
The list of buses covered can change; check with APSRTC (customer care 0866-2570005)
